title: Affineness descends under finite surjective morphisms to Noetherian schemes
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The finite cover need not be flat, so ordinary faithfully flat descent of affineness does not apply. The proof constructs coherent test sheaves above integral support strata and verifies cohomological devissage for all their ideal modifications, forcing H1 vanishing on the target.
